exact_statement: For every strictly increasing sequence of positive moduli n_i and arbitrary residue classes a_i modulo n_i, determine whether the set of natural n such that for every i either n<n_i or n is not congruent to a_i modulo n_i must have a logarithmic density.

Entry is permitted only at the frozen resume gate: prove aggregate cross-scale packing/tightness or construct infinitely many target-isolated blocks with nonvanishing normalised harmonic mass.
Another isolated finite amplifier, finite search champion, or layerwise counterexample is explicitly non-closing.
